basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old from Austin, Texas, who recently got back into gaming after a few years break. I work as a junior graphic designer at a local firm and am currently single. In my free time, I love exploring new games and catching up on classic titles I missed. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and during weekends. I'm a big fan of travel vlogs and often watch Adam the Woo for inspiration. Recently, I've been considering a gastric bypass and researching the process extensively.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a casual gamer, I have a decent understanding of popular gaming franchises like Pokémon, mostly from playing with friends during my school years. My design background gives me an appreciation for art and graphics in games, which I often discuss in my comments.
